description: Search federal disaster declarations by state, incident type, declaration type, date range, and county. Returns deduplicated declaration-level summaries — each disaster number appears once with a designated_area_count showing how many counties/municipalities were designated. The disaster number is the chain key for fema_get_disaster, fema_get_public_assistance, and fema_get_housing_assistance. Use declaration_type to filter: DR (major disaster, most common), EM (emergency), FM (fire management). Date filters apply to the declaration date. Use fema_get_disaster to retrieve all designated-area rows for a specific declaration. county selects the declarations that designated a matching area; their area counts and program flags still describe the whole declaration, and matched_areas lists the matching areas with their own program flags. A search reads the most recent 10,000 designated-area rows; when more match, it returns the declarations dated after the day that window ends, sets truncated, and its notice names the date_to that continues with older declarations. A page holds at most 100,000 characters of declarations; when declarations remain past it, next_offset is the offset to continue from.

county.description: Filter by designated area / county name (e.g., Harris, Los Angeles, dekalb). Case-insensitive substring match: harris also matches Harrison. Selects the declarations that designated a matching area; designated_area_count and the program flags still describe the whole declaration, and matched_areas lists the matching areas.

date_from.description: Start of the declaration date range as a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2024-01-01). Inclusive; not after date_to.

date_to.description: End of the declaration date range as a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2024-12-31). Inclusive; equal to date_from for a single day.

declaration_type.description: Declaration type: DR (major disaster declaration), EM (emergency declaration), FM (fire management assistance declaration).

incident_type.description: Incident type filter (e.g., Flood, Hurricane, Tornado, Fire, Earthquake, Severe Storm). Case-insensitive substring match: storm also matches Snowstorm and Winter Storm.

limit.description: Maximum number of unique disaster declarations to return (1–1000, default 50). A page also stops at 100,000 characters of declarations (roughly 290 declarations, about 190 with county); when either bound leaves matching declarations out, next_offset names the offset to continue from.

offset.description: Pagination offset in declarations (default 0). Pass the previous page’s next_offset to continue.

state.description: Two-letter US state/territory code (e.g., TX, CA, FL, PR). Filters by state.

name: fema_search_disasters

area_totals_unavailable.description: True when county is set and reading the returned declarations’ full designated-area rows failed: designated_area_count and the ia/pa/hm flags then count only the areas county matched, and the notice names the cause. Absent otherwise.

declarations.description: Disaster declarations matching the search from offset onward, one entry per unique disaster number, bounded by limit and by 100,000 characters of declarations.

items.description: Deduplicated summary for one disaster declaration.

declaration_date.description: ISO 8601 date the declaration was signed.

declaration_type.description: Declaration type: DR (major disaster), EM (emergency), or FM (fire management).

designated_area_count.description: Number of counties/municipalities the whole declaration designated, also when county is set — use fema_get_disaster for the full area list.

disaster_number.description: Unique FEMA disaster number — pass to fema_get_disaster, fema_get_public_assistance, or fema_get_housing_assistance.

hm_declared.description: True when Hazard Mitigation grants were declared for any area of the declaration, also when county is set.

ia_declared.description: True when the Individuals and Households Program (IHP) was declared for any area of the declaration — indicates IA housing/personal grants are available. Describes the whole declaration also when county is set; matched_areas carries each matched area’s own flag.

incident_begin_date.description: ISO 8601 incident start date. Absent when not recorded.

incident_end_date.description: ISO 8601 incident end date. Absent for ongoing or unrecorded incidents.

incident_type.description: Type of incident (e.g., Flood, Hurricane, Tornado, Severe Storm).

matched_areas.description: The designated areas of this declaration that county matched, each with the programs declared for that area — which can differ from the declaration: an area designated for PA and HM only has ia_declared false. Present only when county is set.

items.description: One designated area that county matched, with its own program flags.

area.description: Name of the designated area, as stored (e.g., "Bexar (County)").

fips_county_code.description: 3-digit county FIPS code. Absent when not recorded.

fips_state_code.description: 2-digit state FIPS code. Absent when not recorded.

hm_declared.description: True when Hazard Mitigation was declared for this area.

ia_declared.description: True when IHP was declared for this area.

pa_declared.description: True when Public Assistance was declared for this area.
True when Public Assistance (infrastructure recovery grants) was declared for any area of the declaration, also when county is set.

title.description: Official declaration title (e.g., "SEVERE STORMS AND FLOODING").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: The state parameter is not a valid 2-letter US state/territory code. `invalid_range`: date_from is later than date_to, so no declaration could match. `no_results`: Query returned zero disaster declarations. `request_too_long`: The incident_type or county value makes the request URL longer than the roughly 8,900 characters OpenFEMA accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page: offset plus returned_count. Present only while matching declarations remain past this page — when truncated is true, only within the declarations dated after the day the window ends. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Paging guidance: the offset to continue from and whether limit or the response budget ended the page; when offset is at or past the end of the matching declarations, the total and the last valid offset; when truncated is true, that the totals are lower bounds and the date_to (YYYY-MM-DD) to search next for older declarations; when area_totals_unavailable is true, why the area totals could not be read.

returned_count.description: Number of unique deduplicated declarations in this response.

totalCount.description: Unique disaster declarations matching the query — the unit declaration-level pagination pages over. Exceeds returned_count when the matches span more than one page. A lower bound when truncated is true.

total_area_rows.description: Total matching designated-area rows from the API (raw row count, not declaration count) — with county set, the rows of the matching areas only. DisasterDeclarationsSummaries returns one row per designated area per disaster, so this is always ≥ the number of unique declarations. When it exceeds 10,000, the search reads the most recent 10,000 rows and drops the declarations dated on the oldest day among them, so every returned declaration is complete; the notice names the date_to that continues with older declarations.

total_declarations.description: Unique disaster declarations matching the query, before offset/limit paging — the bound for declaration-level pagination (limit/offset apply to declarations, not area rows). A lower bound when truncated is true: it counts only the declarations dated after the day the 10,000-row window ends.

truncated.description: True when more than 10,000 designated-area rows match: the search covers only the declarations dated after the day its 10,000-row window ends. Each returned declaration is complete, the totals are lower bounds, and the notice names the date_to that continues with older declarations. Absent otherwise.

title: Search FEMA Disaster Declarations
